title: Resolve or document permanent summary/store divergence in the isolated switch preview
outcome: Resolve or document permanent summary/store divergence in the isolated switch preview
acceptance: The isolated preview either resolves summary-versus-hydrated lookup divergence after the intended transient render, or explicitly documents that its content-scroll effects remain deferred.
Measurements distinguish the limited static fixture from settled App behavior and do not claim live scroll-restoration coverage from a permanently deferred effect.
